import numpy as np, model
neg = model.negatives()
M=[1,8,11,14,15]
C=np.asarray(neg['c']); A=np.asarray(neg['a'])
T=[]
for i in M:
    b=model.basin(i); pts=b['pts']; lab=b['lab']
    ab=pts[lab==b['bad']].mean(0); angb=np.arctan2(ab[1],ab[0])
    cands=[]
    for l in np.unique(lab):
        if l==b['bad']: continue
        p=pts[lab==l]
        if len(p)<5: continue
        m=p.mean(0)
        # bad if near any other negative action at similar c (any member or other)
        badflag=any(abs(C[j]-C[i])<0.12 and np.linalg.norm(A[j]-m)<0.8 for j in range(len(C)) if j!=i)
        d=np.degrees(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(np.arctan2(m[1],m[0])-angb))))
        cands.append((abs(d),d,badflag,l,m))
    cands.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
    print(neg['uid'][i], round(C[i],3), 'bad ang',round(np.degrees(angb),1), [(round(d,0),bf) for _,d,bf,_,_ in cands[:4]])
    ok=[z for z in cands if not z[2]]
    T.append(ok[0][4]); print('  target',np.round(ok[0][4],2), round(ok[0][1],0))
np.save('../T.npy',np.array(T,dtype=np.float32)) if False else None
import os
np.save('T1.npy',np.array(T,dtype=np.float32)); print(os.listdir('.'))
